title_zh: 电子竞技与游戏成瘾的争论
title_en: The Esports and Gaming Addiction Debate
note_en: 与其A，不如B means "rather than A, it's better to B": 与其一味禁止，不如引导孩子合理规划时间 "rather than just banning games, it's better to guide kids to plan their time sensibly." Note the order: the rejected option comes first after 与其, and the preferred one follows 不如, the same order as English "rather than... better to."
